# Teaching and Learning Mathematics Online

> The official companion site for *Teaching and Learning Mathematics Online*, edited by James P. Howard, II and John F. Beyers, covering the 2020 first edition and the 2025 second edition.

Website: https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/
Editors: James P. Howard, II; John F. Beyers

## Main content

- [About](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/about/): purpose and scope of the companion site.
- [Editions](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/editions/): records for the first and second editions.
- [Chapters](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/chapters/): chapter information organized across both editions.
- [Contributors](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/contributors/): contributor records.
- [Resources](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/resources/): teaching and companion resources.
- [Errata](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/errata/): corrections and errata.
- [Cite](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/cite/): citation guidance.
- [Notices](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/notices/): site notices and rights information.
- [Contact](https://tlmo.jameshoward.us/contact/): public contact information.

## Interpretation notes

This is a companion to the published edited volumes, not a reproduction of the books. Chapter and contributor records should be used together with the edition information when identifying a contribution.

## Related

- [James Howard](https://jameshoward.us/): co-editor profile, scholarship, teaching, and related projects.
